2. The petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with Fatuha P.S. Case No. 903 of 2024 instituted under Sections 120B, 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code lodged on 15.12.2024 by the informant, Ranjan Kumar.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he wants to restore relationship with the opposite party no.2 and has positive mind to make payment for which it would be appropriate that the opposite party no.2 appears in this case.
4. In that background, issue notice to opposite party Patna High Court CR.
